resources.string: Blocks Reels in Instagram and Shorts in YouTube. Everything else in both apps keeps working. RemoveReels only looks at those two apps, saves nothing you see or type, and has no internet access.
Tells you when blocking is off.
Tap to turn it back on.
Keep Instagram and YouTube. Lose Reels and Shorts.
✓ Feed, messages, stories, posting and search keep working.
⏱ You can allow up to 45 minutes a day, starting the day after you set it.
There is no off switch. Uninstalling is the only way to stop it.
RemoveReels uses Android\'s accessibility feature to notice when Instagram or YouTube opens Reels or Shorts.
• It only looks at those two apps.
• It saves nothing you see or type.
RemoveReels sends a single notification, and only when blocking stops: \"Blocking is off. Tap to turn it back on.\"
1. Tap Open settings.\n2. Tap RemoveReels under Installed apps.\n3. Switch it on.
Android protects apps installed from a downloaded file. Allow RemoveReels\' restricted settings first:
1. Tap Open app info.\n2. Tap ⋮ at the top right.\n3. Tap Allow restricted settings.
Reels and Shorts are now blocked in Instagram and YouTube.
This app may have changed. Some of its screens may not be blocked until RemoveReels is updated.
Today: %1$d of %2$d min · resets at midnight
A small timer at the top of the screen while you use an allowance.
RemoveReels only looks at Instagram and YouTube, saves nothing you see or type, and has no internet access.
Built with open-source libraries from Android Jetpack and Kotlin, under the Apache License 2.0.
Some phones stop apps in the background to save battery, which would also stop blocking. These steps keep RemoveReels running:

string-array.name: keep_running_samsung
string-array.item: Open Settings → Apps → RemoveReels → Battery and choose Unrestricted.
Open Settings → Battery → Background usage limits and make sure RemoveReels is not under Sleeping apps or Deep sleeping apps.

string-array.name: keep_running_xiaomi
string-array.item: Open Settings → Apps → Manage apps → RemoveReels and turn on Autostart.
On the same screen, open Battery saver and choose No restrictions.

string-array.name: keep_running_oppo
string-array.item: Open Settings → Apps → RemoveReels → Battery and allow background activity.
Turn off battery optimisation for RemoveReels.

string-array.name: keep_running_vivo
string-array.item: Open Settings → Battery → Background power consumption management and allow RemoveReels to run in the background.
Open i Manager → App manager → Autostart manager and turn on RemoveReels.

string-array.name: keep_running_huawei
string-array.item: Open Settings → Battery → App launch, find RemoveReels and switch it to Manage manually.
Turn on Auto-launch, Secondary launch and Run in background.

string-array.name: keep_running_other
string-array.item: Open Settings → Apps → RemoveReels → Battery and choose Unrestricted or Not optimised.
